Our Services
Who We Are at Jemmy's HVAC

Since 2000, Jemmy's HVAC has been the go-to team in Hackensack, NJ, for folks needing expert HVAC repair, installation, and more. We’re a crew of friendly pros who love fixing your air conditioning on scorching days and tuning up your heating before the chill sets in. With over two decades of making homes comfy, we’re proud to be the name you trust for all things HVAC!

What Drives Our HVAC Experts

We’re not just here to fix your HVAC—we’re on a mission to bring comfort, trust, and peace of mind to every home in Hackensack, NJ, with every job we tackle.

Our Mission

Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable HVAC services that keep your home cozy year-round. We sweat the small stuff so you don’t have to, ensuring every repair or installation is done right the first time. It’s all about making your life easier and your space just perfect!

Our Vision

We see a future where every home in Hackensack, NJ, runs smoothly with top-notch heating and air conditioning—no stress, no fuss. Our vision keeps us pushing to be the best HVAC experts around, always ready with a smile and a solution. We’re building comfort, one happy customer at a time!

Our Core Values

Integrity, quality, and customer satisfaction are at the heart of everything we do as HVAC experts. We promise honest work, fair prices, and a dedication to leaving you thrilled with your heating, cooling, or electrical setup. It’s how we’ve rolled since day one in 2000!
